geometry_review.preprocess: Apply the same explicit full-frame cv::INTER_LINEAR resize to the rectified left/right images, without crop/remap or model-dependent changes to SDK input.
geometry_review.restoration: Spatially resize native disparity to 640x544 and multiply disparity values only by source_width/model_input_width.
geometry_review.reason: Disparity is a horizontal coordinate difference. Changing only image height changes row sampling, not horizontal pixel units.
geometry_review.SDK_mapping_intrinsics: Use recorded 640x544 rectified K and bxf after disparity restoration; do not pass the vertically resized model K to the original mapping pipeline.
geometry_review.invalid_handling: Keep nonfinite/nonpositive invalid support out of interpolation and Q8; Q8 overflow must be rejected/invalidated by the existing policy.
geometry_review.model_semantics_limit: User input dimensions and matching legacy conversion support the integration convention; only real X5 results or model export provenance can establish the model disparity semantics and accuracy.
